summary: The Renault RS01 was the only car fielded by Renault during its initial involvement in Formula One and was powered by the Renault-Gordini V6 1.5 L turbocharged engine, which was the first regularly used turbo engine in the sport's history.

key_statements.statement: The Renault RS01 was the only car fielded by Renault during its initial involvement in Formula One.
The Renault RS01 used the Renault-Gordini V6 1.5 L turbocharged engine, the first regularly used turbo engine in Formula One history.
